constraint: 2 vCPU / 4 GB (docker --cpus=2 --memory=4g, container restarted under the limit before testing)

trials.note: 0% hard failures, but p95/p99 in the tens of seconds - severe request queueing, not a healthy sustained rate
37.1% of requests timed out at the client's 30s timeout

caveat: Measured on a shared, non-dedicated development sandbox already running multiple other processes from this session's earlier experiments (mock-provider, Postgres, Redis, a leftover Gradle daemon, the k6 client itself all competing for the same 8 physical cores as the 2-vCPU-limited gateway container), not an isolated benchmark host. The severe queueing already visible at 1200 concurrency (well before the 2000 target) suggests this is a genuine capacity limit at this resource tier, not purely a test-harness artifact, but a fully clean re-measurement on dedicated hardware is a reasonable follow-up before treating this as a hard product limitation.
